RAM must be used in dual-channel (or greater) mode based on the number of processors in the platform. For example, at least two RAM modules must be installed for single-processor platforms and at least four RAM modules for dual-processor platforms.
Using RAM at a higher frequency, or using RAM in dual-channel (or greater) mode, results in a CPU load decrease and therefore in a performance increase.

The RAM column shows recommended size and number of RAM modules for dual-channel operation, taking into account the number of processors on the platform. For example, 4x 8GB for a dual-processor platform means two 8GB RAM modules per processor for a dual-channel operation.

For a server without viewing clients, recording takes place on the server. Cameras are viewed on the remote operator workstations (clients). Connecting a monitor to the server can be required only for the initial setup and configuration of the system. Any graphics card (including integrated) is suitable for this purpose. For Axxon One (x64), the graphics card must support OpenGL version 2.0 (or higher) with ARB_vertex_program, GL_EXT_blend_func_separate, GL_ARB_framebuffer_object extensions.

For the operator's workstation (client), it is sufficient to use an NVIDIA GeForce GT520 / Intel HD Graphics 530 graphics card (integrated into a 6th-generation Intel Core processor) or a higher-performance GPU.

For hardware-accelerated video decoding (Intel Quick Sync), use the graphics card built into some Intel processors (for example, Intel HD Graphics 530 integrated into a 6th-generation Intel Core processor). This technology allows for faster and more energy-efficient processing of video content. For more information on Intel Quick Sync Technology, see the product documentation.
